content: प्रज्वल् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To burn brightly, blaze up, shine; रणाङ्गानि प्रजज्वलुः <ls>Bk. 14. 98</ls>. .²2 To catch fire, be in flames, blaze up. .²3 To be kindled (as anger), to be incensed or wrathful. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (प्रज्व(ज्वा)लयति) .²1 To kindle, set on fire. .²2 To brighten, illumine, irradiate.
